name: tsv
description: tsv's development root, never published: the npm packages are assembled under crates/tsv_wasm/pkg and crates/tsv_napi/pkg

scripts.build:all: npm run build:release && npm run build:ffi && npm run build:packages && npm run build:napi:packages
scripts.build:ffi:format: npm run build:stamped -- -p tsv_ffi --release --no-default-features --features format --target-dir target/ffi-format
scripts.build:ffi:parse: npm run build:stamped -- -p tsv_ffi --release --no-default-features --features parse --target-dir target/ffi-parse
scripts.build:ffi:all: npm run build:ffi && npm run build:ffi:format && npm run build:ffi:parse
scripts.build:napi:probe: npm run build:stamped -- -p tsv_napi --profile napi --features panic_probe
scripts.build:napi:packages: npm run build:napi && cargo build -p tsv_cli --release && node scripts/roots/build_napi_packages.ts
scripts.build:wasm:deno: node scripts/roots/run_if_stale.ts --target crates/tsv_wasm/pkg/format/deno/tsv_wasm_bg.wasm -- wasm-pack build crates/tsv_wasm --target deno --release --out-dir pkg/format/deno -- --no-default-features --features format
scripts.build:wasm:parse:deno: node scripts/roots/run_if_stale.ts --target crates/tsv_wasm/pkg/parse/deno/tsv_wasm_bg.wasm -- wasm-pack build crates/tsv_wasm --target deno --release --out-dir pkg/parse/deno -- --no-default-features --features parse
scripts.build:wasm:all:deno: node scripts/roots/run_if_stale.ts --target crates/tsv_wasm/pkg/all/deno/tsv_wasm_bg.wasm -- wasm-pack build crates/tsv_wasm --target deno --release --out-dir pkg/all/deno
scripts.build:wasm:all:nodejs: node scripts/roots/run_if_stale.ts --target crates/tsv_wasm/pkg/all/nodejs/tsv_wasm_bg.wasm -- wasm-pack build crates/tsv_wasm --target nodejs --release --out-dir pkg/all/nodejs
scripts.build:npm:format: wasm-pack build crates/tsv_wasm --target web --release --out-dir pkg/format/npm -- --no-default-features --features format && node scripts/roots/patch_npm_package.ts format
scripts.build:npm:parse: wasm-pack build crates/tsv_wasm --target web --release --out-dir pkg/parse/npm -- --no-default-features --features parse && node scripts/roots/patch_npm_package.ts parse
scripts.build:npm:all: wasm-pack build crates/tsv_wasm --target web --release --out-dir pkg/all/npm && node scripts/roots/patch_npm_package.ts all
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:npm:format && npm run build:npm:parse && npm run build:npm:all
scripts.build:bench: npm run build:bench:pgo && npm run build:bench:deno && npm run build:bench:node
scripts.build:bench:deno: npm run build:ffi:format && npm run build:ffi:parse && npm run build:wasm:deno && npm run build:wasm:parse:deno && npm run build:wasm:all:deno
scripts.build:check: npm run build:stamped -- --profile corpus -p tsv_cli -p tsv_debug --features tsv_debug/_internal_audits --quiet
scripts.install-cli: cargo build --release -p tsv_cli && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && cp target/release/tsv ~/.local/bin/tsv
scripts.dev: cargo watch -x 'check --workspace' -x 'test --workspace' || echo '⚠️  cargo-watch not installed. Run: cargo install cargo-watch'
scripts.typecheck:js: node node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.bench.json && deno task typecheck:deno && deno task typecheck:js:deno
scripts.typecheck:features: RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo check -p tsv_wasm -p tsv_ffi -p tsv_napi --no-default-features --features tsv_wasm/format,tsv_ffi/format,tsv_napi/format && RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo check -p tsv_wasm -p tsv_ffi -p tsv_napi --no-default-features --features tsv_wasm/parse,tsv_ffi/parse,tsv_napi/parse && RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo check -p tsv_wasm -p tsv_napi --no-default-features --features tsv_wasm/strip,tsv_napi/strip && RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo check -p tsv_wasm -p tsv_napi --no-default-features --features tsv_wasm/imports,tsv_napi/imports && RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo check -p tsv_ts -p tsv_css -p tsv_svelte --all-targets && RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo check -p tsv_svelte --features smallvec/union
scripts.check: cargo fmt --check && npm run format:audit && npm run pins:audit && npm run docs:audit && npm run docs:audit:docsrs && npm run deps:audit && npm run package:audit && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:features && npm run typecheck:scripts && npm run typecheck:bench-core && npm run conformance:audit && npm run conformance:audit:compiler && npm run variants:audit && npm run scan:audit && npm run fanout:audit && npm run roundtrip:audit && npm run roundtrip:audit:prettier && npm run discovery:audit && npm run canonicalize:audit && npm run binding:audit && npm run authoring:audit && npm run paren:audit && npm run razor:audit && npm run fuzz:audit && npm run fuzz:audit:debug && npm run test:node && deno task test:deno && npm run test && npm run test:depth && npm run test:audits && npm run swallow:audit && npm run comments:audit && npm run gaps:audit && npm run blanks:audit && npm run fabrication:audit && npm run census:audit && npm run width:audit && npm run ignore:audit && npm run check:ast-types && npm run check:loc && npm run lint
scripts.canonicalize:audit: cargo run --profile corpus -p tsv_debug --features _internal_audits --quiet canonicalize_audit tests/fixtures tests/fixtures_compile
scripts.strip:corpus: npm run build:check && npm run strip:corpus:run --
scripts.imports:corpus: npm run build:check && npm run imports:corpus:run --
scripts.corpus:compare:format: npm run build:napi:corpus && npm run corpus:compare:format:run --
scripts.corpus:compare:parse: npm run build:napi:corpus && npm run build:check && npm run corpus:compare:parse:run --
scripts.conformance:svelte-fixtures: npm run build:napi:corpus && npm run conformance:svelte-fixtures:run --
scripts.conformance:ts-fixtures: npm run build:napi:corpus && npm run conformance:ts-fixtures:run --
scripts.conformance:ts-repo: npm run build:napi:corpus && npm run conformance:ts-repo:run --
scripts.css:over-acceptance: npm run build:napi:corpus && npm run build:wasm:all:nodejs && npm run css:over-acceptance:run --
scripts.ts-repo:over-acceptance: npm run build:napi:corpus && npm run build:wasm:all:nodejs && npm run ts-repo:over-acceptance:run --
scripts.conformance: npm run pins:audit:checkouts && npm run bench:pins:suites && npm run fixtures:validate && npm run compile:fixtures:validate && npm run bench:harvest:svelte-styles && npm run build:napi:corpus && npm run build:check && npm run strip:corpus:run && npm run imports:corpus:run && PRETTIER_DEBUG=1 node benches/js/roots/conformance.ts
scripts.conformance:all: npm run conformance:test262 && npm run conformance
scripts.docs:audit: RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D rustdoc::broken_intra_doc_links -D rustdoc::invalid_html_tags -D rustdoc::bare_urls -D rustdoc::redundant_explicit_links -A rustdoc::private_intra_doc_links' cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --document-private-items --all-features --quiet
scripts.test:node: node node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && node node_modules/.bin/vitest run
scripts.test:node:canonical: node node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.canonical.json && node node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config vitest.canonical.config.ts
scripts.test:depth: cargo test --profile corpus -p tsv_tests --features tsv_debug/_internal_audits --test depth_limit --quiet
scripts.test:depth:napi: TSV_DEPTH_SWEEP=full cargo test --profile napi -p tsv_tests --test depth_limit --quiet
scripts.fuzz:audit: cargo run --profile corpus -p tsv_debug --features _internal_audits --quiet fuzz --seed 0 --iterations 5000 && npm run fuzz:audit:css && npm run fuzz:audit:ts
scripts.fuzz:audit:css: cargo run --profile corpus -p tsv_debug --features _internal_audits --quiet fuzz --seed 0 --iterations 5000 --embedded css
scripts.fuzz:audit:ts: cargo run --profile corpus -p tsv_debug --features _internal_audits --quiet fuzz --seed 0 --iterations 5000 --embedded ts tests/fixtures tests/fixtures_strip tests/fixtures_imports
scripts.fuzz:audit:debug: cargo run --profile corpus-debug -p tsv_debug --features _internal_audits --quiet fuzz --seed 0 --iterations 5000 && cargo run --profile corpus-debug -p tsv_debug --features _internal_audits --quiet fuzz --seed 0 --iterations 5000 --embedded css && cargo run --profile corpus-debug -p tsv_debug --features _internal_audits --quiet fuzz --seed 0 --iterations 5000 --embedded ts tests/fixtures tests/fixtures_strip tests/fixtures_imports
scripts.bench: npm run bench:perf && npm run bench:conformance && npm run bench:compose
scripts.bench:perf: npm run bench:runtimes && npm run bench:harvest:svelte-styles && npm run build:bench && deno task bench:deno:run && npm run bench:node:run && npm run bench:bun:run && npm run bench:compose
scripts.bench:deno: npm run build:bench && deno task typecheck:deno && deno task bench:deno:run
scripts.bench:node: npm run build:bench && npm run bench:node:run --
scripts.bench:bun: npm run build:bench && npm run bench:bun:run --
scripts.bench:conformance: npm run bench:pins:suites && npm run build:bench && npm run bench:conformance:run --
scripts.bench:runtimes: (node -e 'if (globalThis.Deno) process.exit(1); const [a, b] = process.versions.node.split(".").map(Number); if (a < 22 || (a === 22 && b < 18)) process.exit(1)' 2> /dev/null || (echo '✗ bench needs node (>=22.18, native TS type-stripping) — a real node, not the deno node-compat shim — install it' && exit 1)) && (which bun > /dev/null || (echo '✗ bench needs bun — install it, or run the per-runtime tasks: npm run bench:deno && npm run bench:node && npm run bench:compose' && exit 1))
scripts.bench:harvest: npm run bench:pins:suites && npm run bench:harvest:svelte-styles
scripts.bench:pins:suites: npm run bench:harvest:wpt && npm run bench:harvest:test262 && npm run bench:harvest:ts-repo && npm run bench:harvest:svelte-rejects && npm run bench:harvest:prettier-jsx && npm run css:over-acceptance:pin
scripts.bench:clean: rm -rf benches/js/results/baseline.json benches/js/results/[0-9]*.json benches/js/results/[0-9]*.md benches/js/results/.run-* benches/js/.cache
scripts.conformance:tsc-check: cargo run -p tsv_debug --quiet tsc_conformance run --report benches/js/results/report.tsc-conformance
scripts.conformance:tsc-check:update: cargo run -p tsv_debug --quiet tsc_conformance run --update --report benches/js/results/report.tsc-conformance
scripts.test:npm: npm run build:npm:format && npm run test:npm:run
scripts.test:npm:run: PKG_DIR=crates/tsv_wasm/pkg/format/npm node --test scripts/test_npm.ts && npm run test:bun -- format
scripts.test:npm:parse: npm run build:npm:parse && npm run test:npm:parse:run
scripts.test:npm:parse:run: PKG_DIR=crates/tsv_wasm/pkg/parse/npm node --test scripts/test_npm.ts && npm run test:bun -- parse
scripts.test:npm:all: npm run build:npm:all && npm run test:npm:all:run
scripts.test:npm:all:run: PKG_DIR=crates/tsv_wasm/pkg/all/npm node --test scripts/test_npm.ts && npm run test:bun -- all
scripts.test:napi: npm run build:napi:probe && npm run test:napi:run
scripts.test:napi:npm: npm run build:napi:packages && npm run test:napi:npm:run
scripts.test:napi:npm:run: node --test scripts/test_napi_npm.ts && npm run test:bun -- napi
